reason: The README describes a local-first DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary user-facing purpose is token usage observability through dashboards, trends, budgets, anomaly indicators, aggregation, exports, and optional usage or session trajectory analysis.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地优先的 Token 用量仪表盘、趋势与预算分析、聚合导出及按需会话轨迹报告。
summaries.en: A local-first DeepSeek Harness plugin for token-usage dashboards, trends, budgets, aggregated exports, and on-demand session trajectory reports.

capabilities: Observes model usage, retry, compaction, and session event metadata
Persists aggregated token statistics, budgets, and limited trajectory reports locally
Provides dashboard visualizations, trends, budgets, anomaly indicators, and public-rate cost estimates
Exports aggregated JSON and CSV data
Optionally invokes a selected connected model using aggregated usage data or allowlisted trajectory metadata
